title: Owner Cross-Branch Financial Analytics
user_visible_behavior: Users logged in as 'owner' can view combined cross-branch financial data including grand_total, total_cost, total_profit, and expenses. They can filter data by daily, weekly, or monthly periods, toggle between branches, and view sparkline charts mapping net profits.
verification: 1. Log in as a user with the 'owner' role. 2. Verify the cross-branch analytics dashboard loads without data leakage. 3. Test daily, weekly, and monthly period filters. 4. Toggle branch selection and verify metrics recalculate. 5. Run tests: tests/Feature/GrossRevenueDetailTest.php, BaseCostDetailTest.php, NetProfitDetailTest.php, ExpensesDetailTest.php
evidence: Owner dashboard component (app/Livewire/Dashboards/Owner.php) implements financial analytics with detail components: GrossRevenueDetail, BaseCostDetail, NetProfitDetail, ExpensesDetail. Multiple passing test files verify dashboard functionality. Owner dashboard dispatches OrderUpdated events for real-time sync. Commit e7bfef1 (feat(owner): Net Profit Detail) and related commits (86f4635, 258ed0e, 17a2711, 049ff1f) confirm implementation.
notes: Financial metrics use invoice-level grand_total (Omset), total_cost (HPP), and total_profit (Laba) as per AGENTS.md naming conventions. Dashboard includes period filtering via updatedPeriod() and branch selection via updatedSelectedBranchId(). Real-time WebSocket listeners active.

title: Manager Inventory and Pricing Matrices
user_visible_behavior: Users logged in as 'manager' can manage material inventory, view stock ledgers, manage display/finishing master data, control the pricing engine matrices, and manage user profiles.
verification: 1. Log in as a user with 'manager' role. 2. Navigate to inventory management and modify material stock level. 3. Verify changes commit to stock ledger. 4. Access pricing engine matrix and modify parameters. 5. Update a user profile (name and email). 6. Run tests: tests/Feature/InventoryManagementTest.php
evidence: Manager dashboard (app/Livewire/Dashboards/Manager.php) with OrderUpdated listeners and material management features. MaterialManagement component (app/Livewire/Admin/MaterialManagement.php) handles create, edit, delete, activate operations using InventoryService and MaterialForm. Tests verify cashier expense logging and material operations. Commit 3787355 (feat(inventory management): register material, edit & delete, owner global material) confirms implementation.
notes: InventoryService (app/Services/InventoryService.php) handles material creation with transaction safety. MaterialBranchStock tracks branch-specific inventory. Stock ledgers automatically updated on material operations. Managers have profile update authorization per AGENTS.md.

title: Cashier Checkouts and Customer Pickup Queue
user_visible_behavior: Users logged in as 'cashier' can process checkouts, accept down payments or full settlements, record drawer expenses, print receipts, and manage the pickup queue displaying orders that are paid but not yet picked up.
verification: 1. Log in as cashier user. 2. Execute checkout workflow with down payment (verify invoice status becomes 1). 3. Process balance settlement (verify status becomes 2). 4. Verify pickup queue shows only records where pickup_status=0 and invoice status=2. 5. Log cashier drawer expense. 6. Print receipt. 7. Run tests: tests/Feature/CashieringTest.php
evidence: Cashier dashboard (app/Livewire/Dashboards/Cashier.php) implements checkout, payment, and expense features. CashieringTest.php verifies down payment registration with Event::fake() detecting OrderUpdated dispatch. Tests confirm invoice status transitions (0->1->2) and pickup queue management. PaymentService handles payment processing. OrderUpdated events broadcast to real-time dashboards.
evidence_logs: CashieringTest::test_cashier_can_register_down_payment - PASSING. User with cashier role creates down payment, invoice status set to 1. Event(OrderUpdated) dispatched for real-time sync.
notes: Invoice status codes: 0=unpaid, 1=down payment, 2=fully paid. Pickup status: 0=not picked, 1=picked. Cashier role restricted from profile name/email edits (password only).

title: Designer Customer Wizard and Pricing Calculator
user_visible_behavior: Users logged in as 'designer' can use a customer selection/creation wizard, enter order parameters such as dimensions and choices, view a real-time pricing preview, and print job tickets.
verification: 1. Log in as designer user. 2. Open customer creation wizard and fill order parameters. 3. Input custom dimensions for order item. 4. Verify PricingService updates frontend pricing preview in real-time. 5. Generate and print Work Order job ticket sheet. 6. Verify calculator form validation and pricing precision.
evidence: Designer dashboard (app/Livewire/Dashboards/Designer.php, 17KB) implements comprehensive ordering features with CustomerForm, CalculatorForm, and PricingService integration. Uses constructor dependency injection to load pricing data dynamically. PricingService (app/Services/PricingService.php) implements calculateQuote() method matching product/material/machine/finishing/cut/display parameters with tiered quantity pricing. Multiple form objects handle customer and calculator input validation.
notes: PricingService handles complex pricing matrix logic including tiered quantities, customer types, branch-specific pricing, and attribute/machine/finishing multipliers. Uses Livewire form objects for input validation. Calculator form submitted via Livewire property binding for real-time updates. Job ticket printing via Work Order template.

title: Production Print Queue and Waste Logging
user_visible_behavior: Users logged in as 'production' can view the print queue, assign jobs to specific printer machines, log material waste, and mark jobs as completed.
verification: 1. Log in as production user. 2. View print queue and assign order to machine (verify order status becomes 1). 3. Log failed print entry using waste logger. 4. Verify database insertion into wasted_materials table. 5. Mark job as completed (status 2) and verify InventoryService decrements stock ledger. 6. Run tests: tests/Feature/ProductionDashboardTest.php
evidence: Production dashboard (app/Livewire/Dashboards/Production.php) implements queue, waste logging, and order completion features. Uses WasteLogForm for waste entry validation. OrderService handles startProduction() and completeProduction() methods. InventoryService handles stock ledger decrements. OrderUpdated events dispatched on production actions. Tests verify production workflow transitions.
notes: Order status codes: 0=pending, 1=processing, 2=completed. WastedMaterial model tracks failed prints with operator name, material, quantity, and timestamps. InventoryService wraps all stock mutations in DB::transaction() for safety. All production actions dispatch OrderUpdated for real-time dashboard updates.

title: Multi-Branch Tenancy Data Isolation
user_visible_behavior: Users from different branches cannot view, modify, or access each other's invoices, order details, job tickets, or print receipts unless they hold the owner role.
verification: 1. Log in as cashier assigned to Branch A. 2. Attempt direct URL access to invoice route of Branch B (/orders/{invoice}/receipt). 3. Verify authorization middleware denies access with 403 response. 4. Switch to owner role and verify cross-branch access allowed. 5. Run feature tests: tests/Feature/BranchAuthorizationAndScopingTest.php
evidence: BranchAuthorizationAndScopingTest.php tests cross-branch restrictions. Production dashboard (line 56-58, 73-75) validates branch_id match before operations. MaterialManagement (line 77-79) enforces branch authorization. Test case test_non_owner_cannot_access_other_branch_ticket_and_receipt verifies 403 abort on unauthorized access. Branch-scoped queries throughout service layer.
notes: Authorization checks use if (auth()->user()->branch_id && ...) pattern throughout dashboards. Invoice, Order, Material, and Stock Ledger models include branch_id foreign key. Owner role bypasses branch scoping. Tests include RefreshDatabase for proper isolation testing.

title: Real-Time UI State Reactivity via Reverb
user_visible_behavior: When an order is created, payment status changes, or a print job completes, all relevant dashboard screens update instantly without a manual page refresh.
verification: 1. Open two browser sessions (Cashier and Production). 2. As Cashier, complete payment settlement updating order. 3. Observe Production print queue update immediately without page reload. 4. Verify App\Events\OrderUpdated broadcasts to public 'orders' channel via host port 8084. 5. Check browser console Echo listeners confirm subscription and message delivery.
evidence: OrderUpdated event (app/Events/OrderUpdated.php) implements ShouldBroadcastNow, broadcasts to Channel('orders') with broadcastAs() returning 'OrderUpdated'. All dashboards (Owner, Manager, Cashier, Designer, Production) register protected $listeners = ['echo:orders,OrderUpdated' => '$\$refresh']. AdminComponents (BranchManagement, MaterialManagement, UserManagement) dispatch event(new OrderUpdated) after state changes. Reverb configured for port 8080 (container) mapped to 8084 (host).
notes: WebSocket integration uses Laravel Echo with Reverb broadcaster. Livewire components automatically refresh on Echo event receipt. OrderUpdated events dispatched from: UserManagement, BranchManagement, MaterialManagement, Production, Designer, Cashier. No payload needed - event signals dashboards to refresh from latest server state.

title: Dynamic Light and Dark Mode Support
user_visible_behavior: The interface changes visual themes immediately when toggled, respecting the localStorage state and maintaining sufficient text contrast across all dropdowns, modals, and input variables.
verification: 1. Locate theme toggle button in sidebar navigation. 2. Toggle between light and dark modes. 3. Verify HTML root element updates with dark class. 4. Inspect localStorage to confirm theme preference persisted. 5. Refresh page and verify theme preference restored from localStorage. 6. Inspect text contrast across modals, dropdowns, and inputs in both themes.
evidence: Theme toggle component (resources/views/components/navigation/theme-toggle.blade.php) implements Alpine.js @click handler toggling document.documentElement classList and setting localStorage. CSS implements dark mode via Tailwind dark: prefix on all theme-aware elements (dark:bg-surface-600, dark:text-white, dark:border-surface-300, etc.). Welcome and component views demonstrate dark: variant coverage. App CSS includes brand color definitions for both themes.
notes: Tailwind CSS v4 theme configuration stored in resources/css/app.css via @theme directive (no tailwind.config.js per AGENTS.md). All interactive elements use responsive Tailwind classes for both light/dark modes. localStorage.setItem('theme', 'light'|'dark') persists user preference. document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme') set for CSS custom property access if needed.

title: Branch Management and Administration
user_visible_behavior: Owner role users can create new branches, edit existing branch details, toggle branch status (active/inactive), and delete branches. Branch operations trigger real-time updates across all dashboards.
verification: 1. Log in as owner user. 2. Navigate to Branch Management. 3. Create new branch via form modal with name and code. 4. Edit existing branch details. 5. Toggle branch status active/inactive. 6. Delete branch and verify soft delete. 7. View deactivated branches toggle. 8. Run tests: tests/Feature/BranchManagementTest.php
evidence: BranchManagement component (app/Livewire/Admin/BranchManagement.php) implements full CRUD with ownership authorization check (line 50-52). BranchService (app/Services/BranchService.php) handles business logic for create, update, delete operations. BranchForm handles validation. Component dispatches OrderUpdated after all operations for real-time sync. Tests verify create, update, toggle, and delete workflows.
notes: Branch management restricted to 'owner' role only (authorization check in mount()). Uses BranchForm for validation and BranchService for business logic per service-oriented architecture. Soft deletes via SoftDeletes trait. Real-time updates via OrderUpdated broadcast events.

title: Global Material Catalog and Branch Stock Management
user_visible_behavior: Manager and owner users can register global materials with product category, type, dimensions, and pricing. Materials can be activated for specific branches, with stock levels tracked per branch. Deleted materials can be viewed and reactivated.
verification: 1. Log in as manager/owner. 2. Navigate to Material Management. 3. Create new material via MaterialForm with category and pricing. 4. Activate material for branch via wizard. 5. Update material stock levels via restock form. 6. Edit material details. 7. Soft delete material. 8. Toggle show deleted materials view. 9. Activate deleted material. 10. Run tests: tests/Feature/MaterialManagementTest.php
evidence: MaterialManagement component (app/Livewire/Admin/MaterialManagement.php, 16KB) implements material CRUD, activation wizard, and stock management. InventoryService.createGlobalMaterial() handles material creation with transaction safety and logging. MaterialBranchStock tracks branch-specific stock. Component uses OrderUpdated events for real-time updates. Multiple form objects (MaterialForm, RestockForm) handle validation. Tests verify material operations and stock tracking.
evidence_logs: MaterialManagementTest.php verifies: manager can register material, material appears in inventory, stock ledger updates on restock, material can be activated for branch, deleted materials can be viewed.
notes: Material model includes product_category_id, type, dimensions, cost, price. MaterialBranchStock joins Material with Branch for multi-tenancy. InventoryService uses DB::transaction() for atomic operations. Similarity warning checks for duplicate materials. Success alerts provide user feedback. All operations dispatch OrderUpdated.

user_visible_behavior: Owner users can create, edit, deactivate, and reactivate user accounts with role assignment (owner, manager, cashier, designer, production). Users can be assigned to specific branches.
verification: 1. Log in as owner. 2. Navigate to User Management. 3. Create new user with role and branch assignment. 4. Edit user profile and role. 5. Deactivate user (soft delete). 6. View deactivated users. 7. Reactivate deactivated user. 8. Verify non-owner cannot access user management. 9. title: Pricing Calculation Service Engine
user_visible_behavior: The pricing engine accurately calculates quotes based on product, material, machine, finishing, cut, display selections, order quantity, dimensions, and customer type. Pricing respects tiered quantity discounts and branch-specific pricing matrices.
verification: 1. Open Designer pricing calculator. 2. Select product, material, machine, finishing. 3. Enter quantity and dimensions. 4. Verify pricing updates in real-time. 5. Test tiered quantity pricing by increasing quantity. 6. Test different customer types (Reguler, etc.). 7. Verify branch-specific pricing loads correctly. 8. Run unit/feature tests for PricingService.
evidence: PricingService (app/Services/PricingService.php) implements calculateQuote() method with comprehensive pricing logic. Matches product/material/customer_type/tiered_qty, applies attribute/machine/finishing multipliers, calculates area-based costs for dimensional products. Uses Pricing, AttributePricing, MachinePricing models. Designer dashboard integrates service via constructor dependency injection. Handles exceptions via PricingNotFoundException.
notes: Service supports multiple calculation archetypes. Tiered quantity matching via min_qty <= quantity ordering by min_qty desc. Branch-specific pricing via branch_id parameter. Exception handling via PricingNotFoundException. Parameter validation via InvalidArgumentException.

title: Inventory and Stock Ledger Service
user_visible_behavior: The inventory service manages material stock levels per branch, tracks stock ledger entries, logs wasted materials, and automatically adjusts inventory when orders are completed.
verification: 1. Create order and verify stock ledger entries created. 2. Log material waste in production. 3. Verify wasted_materials table updated. 4. Complete order production and verify stock ledger decremented. 5. Check material branch stock reflects all adjustments. 6. Run tests: tests/Feature/ProductionDashboardTest.php, InventoryManagementTest.php
evidence: InventoryService (app/Services/InventoryService.php) implements createGlobalMaterial(), addMaterialStock(), logWaste(), and completeProduction() methods with transaction safety. All mutations wrapped in DB::transaction() for atomic operations. Logs structured errors via Log::error() with user_id and branch_id context. StockLedger model tracks all inventory movements. WastedMaterial model logs failed prints.
notes: All database operations atomic via DB::transaction(). Error handling via try-catch with structured logging. Service methods accept array parameters for flexibility. UUIDs used for all IDs (Str::uuid()). Integrates with WastedMaterial and StockLedger models.

title: Role-Based Access Control and Authorization
user_visible_behavior: Application enforces strict role-based access with owner, manager, cashier, designer, and production roles. Each role sees only authorized dashboard tabs and features. Unauthorized access attempts result in 403 responses.
verification: 1. Log in with each role (owner, manager, cashier, designer, production). 2. Verify each role sees appropriate dashboard tabs. 3. Attempt unauthorized action (e.g., cashier tries material management). 4. Verify 403 response and auth policy rejection. 5. Run tests: tests/Feature/UserAuthorizationTest.php
evidence: Authorization checks throughout dashboards and components via auth()->user()->role checks and auth()->user()->can() gate checks. BranchManagement requires owner role (line 50-52 of BranchManagement.php). Production dashboard checks branch_id for scoping. Policies and gates defined in AuthServiceProvider. Tests verify authorization boundaries.
evidence_logs: UserAuthorizationTest.php verifies each role cannot access unauthorized features. BranchAuthorizationAndScopingTest verifies branch isolation. Tests confirm 403 abort on unauthorized access.
notes: Role strings: 'owner', 'manager', 'cashier', 'designer', 'production'. Profile update restricted to owner/manager per AGENTS.md. Branch scoping applied per role. Gates and policies enforce authorization boundaries.
